A008.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.iid_meanPredict_excess_nonneg

A008.body_finding: Rewrites the proved finite excess identity, then sums nonnegative square integrals. This is expected nonnegativity, not pathwise regret or convergence.

A009.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.source_mean_optimal

A009.body_finding: Pointwise unit support yields L2/L1 and mean feasibility by integral order; all-real square decomposition gives attainment and universal lower bound. No min/expectation interchange.

seven_slots.terminal: Composed history policy independent of current target

A010.body_finding: Disjoint range t and singleton t under iIndepFun produce tuple independence; measurable scalar policy and current projection compose it. No same-law or support premise.

seven_slots.source_delta: Global off-cube bound strictly stronger than legal-cube; no fullsource class closure

A011.body_finding: Actual history composition is measurable and globally bounded, hence L2; current target is L2. Actual history independence and square decomposition leave a nonnegative centered integral and current-round variance.
